name: Attire Adaptation
body:
School divination; Level bard 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, spiritualist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2; Focus sybarite 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (an outfit worn by you)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hour/level

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, choose a skill associated with an outfit you are wearing. For the duration, while you wear the attire, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks made with that skill, are treated as trained in the skill, and gain a working understanding of the jargon used by practitioners of the skill in languages you know. If you are trained in the skill, the bonus increases to +4. If the outfit is part of a disguise, you gain the same bonus to your relevant Disguise checks.
